mapper.select: select con.Con_Name as conName, con.Con_Code as conCode, pro.P_Name as pName, proc.C_Name as pConstructionUnitName, proc.C_Abbreviation as pConsAbbName, prod.D_Name as pCompetentDepartmentName, f.file_relation_id as fileRelationId, sec.Sec_Name as secInfoName, mn.* from Con_Construction_Org_Design mn left join Con_Contract con on con.Con_Id=mn.Con_Id left join Sec_Info sec on sec.Sec_Id=mn.Sec_Id left join Pre_Project pro on pro.P_Id=mn.P_Id left join SYS_Company proc on proc.C_Id=pro.P_Construction_Unit left join SYS_Department prod on prod.D_Id=pro.P_Competent_Department left join Sys_File f on f.FileID=mn.Cod_Id where mn.Cod_Id=#{codId}
